title: Dynamo
definition: A dynamo is an electrical generator that creates direct current (DC) using a commutator, converting mechanical rotation into electrical energy through electromagnetic induction.
importanceInUpsc: Tested extensively in Prelims under General Science (physics principles, electromagnetic induction) and in Mains GS Paper 3 (Science and Tech - indigenous technology, energy infrastructure applications).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Dynamo.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
